title: K8gb进入CNCF孵化阶段，OpenCost关注Kubernetes推理成本
english: On August 5, 2026, the CNCF Technical Oversight Committee voted to accept Kubernetes Global Balancer (K8gb) as a CNCF incubating project. K8gb is an open-source, cloud-native Global Server Load Balancing solution. On the same day, CNCF highlighted OpenCost 1.121.0 as introducing Kubernetes inference cost tracking, addressing the operational question of how much each model-served token costs. Together, these developments connect two practical concerns for senior platform engineers: resilient traffic distribution across global environments and more granular cost visibility for AI inference workloads. They also show how cloud-native infrastructure is expanding from cluster management toward globally distributed services and AI-aware financial operations.
chinese: CNCF技术监督委员会已投票接受Kubernetes Global Balancer（K8gb）成为CNCF孵化项目。K8gb是一个开源、云原生的全球服务器负载均衡（GSLB）解决方案。CNCF同时介绍了OpenCost 1.121.0，其重点是Kubernetes推理成本跟踪，帮助回答模型服务中每个Token实际成本的问题。
why_it_matters: K8gb与跨全球环境的流量分配和服务可用性相关，属于云原生平台基础设施；OpenCost的推理成本跟踪则直接连接Kubernetes、GPU密集型AI服务和AIOps中的成本可观测性。对资深运维开发而言，这意味着平台能力正在同时覆盖全球流量治理与AI工作负载的成本管理。
interview_expression: I am interested in how cloud-native platforms are evolving to support both global traffic management and AI inference cost visibility. These capabilities are relevant to operating reliable and financially accountable platform services.
